item.text: The failures cluster around preprocessing boundaries: emphasis currently runs separately on text chunks, so it cannot match delimiters across code spans or parsed links, and escaped punctuation is processed after delimiter matching. The overlapping delimiter cases also expose a stack-resolution bug. I’m checking the inline integration points now so the repair preserves existing code-span and escape behavior.
